item.title: Hyogo Girls' Trip: Shopping, Cafes & Onsen Pamper Day
item.description: Hyogo Prefecture has the structural bones of an ideal girls' trip: a sophisticated harbor city whose café culture and shopping districts rival anything in Osaka, a white feudal castle surrounded by cherry trees that delivers exactly the visual Japan that motivated the trip, a mountain onsen town purpose-built for group bathing and indulgence, and a canal town where wearing a yukata is not a tourist costume but the accepted evening dress code for everyone present.
